finding: The fixed-head full Adam update was not constrained by a TRAIN decrease check. First VAL fell from 52.4% to 15.6%; subsequent sampled TRAIN objective rose from 1.727 to 16.329. E5 and E10 head refits reduced their own fixed-feature objectives to 1.705 and 1.722 and recovered VAL to 52.3% and 51.5%. Different epochs use different random D4 codes, so their objectives are not a controlled paired line-search measurement.
interpretation: Step size and optical/head coordination are plausible causes. This does not establish overfitting or a model capacity bound.
